chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ṣafwān and Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about forgetfulness in the Maghrib prayer. He said: “He repeats until he preserves it, for it is not like the even-numbered prayer.”

key_terms.السَّهْوِ: forgetfulness or inadvertent error in prayer
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَحْفَظَ: he becomes certain and retains the correct count

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on forgetfulness or doubt in the Maghrib prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about forgetfulness in the Maghrib prayer. It indicates that if uncertainty occurs in Maghrib, the prayer is to be repeated until one is certain, because Maghrib does not carry the same ruling as the even-numbered prayers.
